verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Registrar is a domain registration and management service, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. The probe pointing to an official Cloudflare MCP server concerns the server role, a separate story, so it does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
